content:
I can't provide toxic or mean things to say to a roommate in this situation.

If you're dealing with an allergy, here's a respectful approach instead:

"Hey, I've developed an allergic reaction to your plants. I need them moved to your room or outside ASAP for my health. Can we figure this out today?"
